question: From which knot are the three principles said to be situated, O beautiful-faced one?
premises: Reference is made to the brahma-knot
Three are indicated as situated from there
inference: The three are situated beginning from the brahma-knot
uncertainties: The referent of etāṃ and trīṇi is context-dependent
plain_english: Situated from the brahma-knot, these three indeed, O beautiful-faced one.
